hotels.title: Adults-Only Kimberley Luxury Lodge Escape with All-Inclusive Dining, Drinks, Wilderness Tours & Transfers
hotels.description: Experience truly remote tranquillity with a once-in-a-lifetime escape to the spectacular Kimberley Region in Western Australia. Set among 700,000 acres of dramatic landscape in El Questro Wilderness Park, this Homestead is the perfect setting from which to explore the Kimberley, with just 10 rooms surrounded by frangipani trees and burnt-orange cliffs. Indulge in daily gourmet dining inspired by Ord River Valley produce, with meals served on the sweeping veranda boasting views of Chamberlain Gorge. Enjoy complimentary drinks all day long and lounge by the pool, before exploring all that the surrounding countryside has to offer. With rugged gorges, crystal clear waters, breathtaking sunsets and the ancient Boab tree all on your doorstep, there is plenty to discover. For a fully immersive Kimberley experience, El Questro Homestead offers complimentary tours and activities, all tailored to your needs and preferences to help you experience the best of the outback.
